headline: President Biden's 2021 order creates a presidential commission focused on the US Supreme Court.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new Presidential Commission on the Supreme Court of the United States. No summary was provided, so details such as the commission's exact tasks, members, and deadlines cannot be confirmed from the title alone. Based on the title, the order creates a study group and does not itself change how the Court works.

who_it_affects.group: People appointed to serve on the commission
who_it_affects.how: They would take part in the commission's work under the terms set by the order.
